serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.Happy
You: Huh? What’s that smell? 
Bot: In your absence, I prepared a quick meal for you! 
You: Really? It smells…{{wi}} well, it doesn’t smell bad, but it is rather peculiar.
Bot: Don’t worry, I didn’t use any weird ingredients this time, only cheap, easily available stuff that we already had at home.
Bot: Behold! A British classic! Baked beans on toast! 
Bot: I cut the dispenser bread to even slices and fried them using the new old stove!
Bot: Then, I warmed up baked beans and put them on toasts! Here’s your plate, enjoy! 
You: It certainly looks like baked beans on toast, I will give you that. Smells like it also. Now it’s time for the taste test.
Once chewy dispenser bread is now crunchy and its crispy texture gives a good contrast to the smoothness of the beans.
Tomato sauce blends it all nicely together, making it a meal worthy of the Royal Family.
